test_vectors: Exhaustive 64 combinations of AVX usable state, AVX2, AVX-512F, AVX-512BW, AVX2 scanner support, and AVX-512 scanner support; checks every capability field and all four backend predicates.
All-disabled and all-enabled boundaries, scalar-only defaults, absent CPU features despite available scanner builds, and absent scanner builds despite usable CPU/OS features.
Negative paths: missing AVX OS state rejects AVX2 and AVX-512; F-only and BW-only reject AVX-512; independent scanner gates cannot enable each other.
AVX-512F plus BW qualifies without AVX2 scanner support or a VL requirement.
Public detection and availability agree, scalar is always available, and enabled native feature fields imply the corresponding scanner supports execution.
Target-gated assertions cover std x86 usable-state checks, no_std x86 exact static guarantees, AArch64 scanner-controlled NEON, and scalar-only unsupported targets including arm32.
